title: Ignoble Expressions
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 8.67 Numbered Discourses 8.67
  • 7. Bhūmicālavagga 7. Earthquakes

Anariyavohārasutta Ignoble Expressions

“Aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, anariyavohārā. “Mendicants, there are these eight ignoble expressions. Katame aṭṭha? What eight? Adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, asute sutavāditā, amute mutavāditā, aviññāte viññātavāditā, diṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, sute asutavāditā, mute amutavāditā, viññāte aviññātavāditā. Saying you’ve seen, heard, thought, or known something, but you haven’t. And saying you haven’t seen, heard, thought, or known something, but you have. Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha anariyavohārā”ti. These are the eight ignoble expressions.”

Sattamaṁ.
